name: Mana Coat
summary: Defense equals the wearer's Intelligence modifier (maximum 6).

description: Magic Damage -3: magic damage taken is reduced by 3 (not poison, disease, curse or psychic damage). Comes as maid or butler clothing; either can be worn regardless of gender. Grapplers may equip it (they can still attack and evade with the Grappler class).

name: Windbreaker Surcoat
summary: Once a day, automatically negates a wind-type attack or effect.
description: Once per day, when the wearer is targeted by a wind-type spell, unique skill or effect, it can negate it (Neg), even if its Resistance is Can't (Details CR III p.233, Pop. 8).
